lines.raw: Compare the two methods: Safe Harbor and Expert Determination.

lines.raw: Why de-identify?
lines.say: Why de-identify?

lines.raw: Analysts, researchers and software testers often need claims data, but not the **people** behind it.
lines.say: Analysts, researchers and software testers often need claims data, but not the people behind it.

lines.raw: If data is properly **de-identified**, it is **no longer PHI**, and HIPAA's rules no longer apply to it.
lines.say: If data is properly de-identified, it is no longer P H I, and HIPAA's rules no longer apply to it.

lines.raw: That makes it much easier and safer to share, study and build with.
lines.say: That makes it much easier and safer to share, study and build with.

lines.raw: A survey report in Nepal.
lines.say: A survey report in Nepal.

lines.raw: A national health survey might report "fever was most common among children under 5 in Province X".
lines.say: A national health survey might report "fever was most common among children under 5 in Province X".

lines.raw: It never lists which families were visited.
lines.say: It never lists which families were visited.

lines.raw: The useful **pattern** is kept; the **people** are hidden.
lines.say: The useful pattern is kept; the people are hidden.

lines.raw: De-identification does the same with claims.
lines.say: De-identification does the same with claims.

lines.raw: Two ways to de-identify.
lines.say: Two ways to de-identify.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **How**. Safe Harbor: Remove all **18 identifiers** (from the PHI lesson) for the person, relatives, employer and household. Expert Determination: A qualified expert (usually a statistician) studies the data and decides the risk of identifying anyone is **very small**.
lines.say: How. Safe Harbor: Remove all 18 identifiers (from the P H I lesson) for the person, relatives, employer and household. Expert Determination: A qualified expert (usually a statistician) studies the data and decides the risk of identifying anyone is very small.

lines.raw: **Extra condition**. Safe Harbor: You must have no actual knowledge that what remains could identify someone. Expert Determination: The expert must document the methods and results.
lines.say: Extra condition. Safe Harbor: You must have no actual knowledge that what remains could identify someone. Expert Determination: The expert must document the methods and results.

lines.raw: **Dates and ZIPs**. Safe Harbor: Year only; ZIP cut to 3 digits (or `000` for small areas). Expert Determination: Can often keep more detail, e.g. months, or dates shifted by a random number of days.
lines.say: Dates and Z I P's. Safe Harbor: Year only; Z I P cut to 3 digits (or 000 for small areas). Expert Determination: Can often keep more detail, for example months, or dates shifted by a random number of days.

lines.raw: **Good for**. Safe Harbor: Simple, checklist-style, easy to verify. Expert Determination: Analysis that needs more detail, such as trends by month.
lines.say: Good for. Safe Harbor: Simple, checklist-style, easy to verify. Expert Determination: Analysis that needs more detail, such as trends by month.

lines.raw: **Cost**. Safe Harbor: Low. Expert Determination: Higher: you pay an expert and repeat when data or use changes.
lines.say: Cost. Safe Harbor: Low. Expert Determination: Higher: you pay an expert and repeat when data or use changes.

lines.raw: The ZIP and age details.
lines.say: The Z I P and age details.

lines.raw: Under Safe Harbor, the first 3 digits of a ZIP code may stay only if all ZIPs starting with those digits together have **more than 20,000 people**; otherwise use `000`.
lines.say: Under Safe Harbor, the first 3 digits of a Z I P code may stay only if all Z I P's starting with those digits together have more than 20,000 people; otherwise use 000.

lines.raw: Ages over 89 become a single group, **90 or older**.
lines.say: Ages over 89 become a single group, 90 or older.

lines.raw: The middle option: a limited data set.
lines.say: The middle option: a limited data set.

scenes.section: The middle option: a limited data set

lines.raw: Sometimes analysts need full dates or 5-digit ZIPs, for example to study hospital readmissions within 30 days.
lines.say: Sometimes analysts need full dates or 5-digit Z I P's, for example to study hospital readmissions within 30 days.

lines.raw: A **limited data set** removes the direct identifiers (names, street addresses, phone and email, SSN, member and account numbers, photos and similar) but may keep **dates**, **city, state and ZIP**, and **ages**.
lines.say: A limited data set removes the direct identifiers (names, street addresses, phone and email, S S N, member and account numbers, photos and similar) but may keep dates, city, state and Z I P, and ages.

scenes.section: The middle option: a limited data set

lines.raw: Limited data set (LDS).
lines.say: Limited data set (L D S).

lines.raw: Still PHI, but with direct identifiers removed.
lines.say: Still P H I, but with direct identifiers removed.

lines.raw: Allowed only for **research, public health or health care operations**.
lines.say: Allowed only for research, public health or health care operations.

lines.raw: Data use agreement (DUA).
lines.say: Data use agreement (D U A).

lines.raw: A contract the receiver must sign before getting a limited data set.
lines.say: A contract the receiver must sign before getting a limited data set.

lines.raw: It promises not to re-identify anyone or contact them, and to protect the data.
lines.say: It promises not to re-identify anyone or contact them, and to protect the data.

lines.raw: Safe Harbor: what happens to each field.
lines.say: Safe Harbor: what happens to each field.

lines.raw: `first_name`, `last_name`. Identifier?: Yes (#1 names). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.
lines.say: first_name, last_name. Identifier?: Yes (#1 names). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.

lines.raw: `street`, `city`. Identifier?: Yes (#2 geography). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.
lines.say: street, city. Identifier?: Yes (#2 geography). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.

lines.raw: `zip`. Identifier?: Yes (#2). Action: Keep first 3 digits (the 787 area has far more than 20,000 people). Result: `787`.
lines.say: zip. Identifier?: Yes (#2). Action: Keep first 3 digits (the 787 area has far more than 20,000 people). Result: 787.

lines.raw: `state`. Identifier?: No. Action: Keep. Result: `TX`.
lines.say: state. Identifier?: No. Action: Keep. Result: T X.

lines.raw: `dob`. Identifier?: Yes (#3 dates). Action: Keep year only; add age at service. Result: `1990`, age `34`.
lines.say: dob. Identifier?: Yes (#3 dates). Action: Keep year only; add age at service. Result: 1 9 9 0, age 34.

lines.raw: `from_dt`. Identifier?: Yes (#3 dates). Action: Keep year only. Result: `2025`.
lines.say: from_dt. Identifier?: Yes (#3 dates). Action: Keep year only. Result: 2 0 2 5.

lines.raw: `phone`. Identifier?: Yes (#4). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.
lines.say: phone. Identifier?: Yes (#4). Action: Remove. Result: Gone.

lines.raw: `member_id`. Identifier?: Yes (#9 health plan number). Action: Replace with a **random** study ID. Result: `P-58213`.
lines.say: member_id. Identifier?: Yes (#9 health plan number). Action: Replace with a random study I D. Result: P dash 5 8 2 1 3.

lines.raw: `claim_id`. Identifier?: Yes (#18 unique code). Action: Replace with a random ID. Result: `C-90417`.
lines.say: claim_id. Identifier?: Yes (#18 unique code). Action: Replace with a random I D. Result: C dash 9 0 4 1 7.

lines.raw: `gender`, `cpt`, `principal_dx`, amounts. Identifier?: No. Action: Keep. Result: Unchanged.
lines.say: gender, cpt, principal_dx, amounts. Identifier?: No. Action: Keep. Result: Unchanged.

lines.raw: Why not just hash the member ID?
lines.say: Why not just hash the member I D?

lines.raw: It is tempting to turn `M1001` into a scrambled code with a hash function.
lines.say: It is tempting to turn M 1 0 0 1 into a scrambled code with a hash function.

lines.raw: But member IDs follow a pattern, so anyone can hash every possible ID and match them back.
lines.say: But member I D's follow a pattern, so anyone can hash every possible I D and match them back.

lines.raw: Under Safe Harbor, a replacement code must **not be derived** from the person's information.
lines.say: Under Safe Harbor, a replacement code must not be derived from the person's information.

lines.raw: Use a **random** ID and keep the lookup table (random ID to real ID) locked away, never shared with the data.
lines.say: Use a random I D and keep the lookup table (random I D to real I D) locked away, never shared with the data.

lines.raw: Why it matters for data work.
lines.say: Why it matters for data work.

lines.raw: Before you share a dataset, ask: **who needs it, and how much detail?**
lines.say: Before you share a dataset, ask: who needs it, and how much detail?

lines.raw: A Safe Harbor file can go to a wider audience; a limited data set needs a data use agreement; full PHI needs a reason under the Privacy Rule.
lines.say: A Safe Harbor file can go to a wider audience; a limited data set needs a data use agreement; full P H I needs a reason under the Privacy Rule.

lines.raw: Picking the lightest option that still answers the question is minimum necessary in action.
lines.say: Picking the lightest option that still answers the question is minimum necessary in action.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: Properly de-identified data is not PHI, so HIPAA's rules no longer apply to it.
lines.say: Properly de-identified data is not P H I, so HIPAA's rules no longer apply to it.

lines.raw: Safe Harbor removes all 18 identifiers (keeping only the year of dates and, where allowed, the first 3 ZIP digits); Expert Determination has an expert certify that the risk is very small.
lines.say: Safe Harbor removes all 18 identifiers (keeping only the year of dates and, where allowed, the first 3 Z I P digits); Expert Determination has an expert certify that the risk is very small.

lines.raw: A limited data set keeps dates and city, state and ZIP; it is still PHI, allowed only for research, public health or operations, under a data use agreement.
lines.say: A limited data set keeps dates and city, state and Z I P; it is still P H I, allowed only for research, public health or operations, under a data use agreement.

lines.raw: Replace IDs with random codes, not hashes of real IDs, and lock the lookup table away.
lines.say: Replace I D's with random codes, not hashes of real I D's, and lock the lookup table away.
